title: Honouring the Guest
arabic_text: عن [أبي هُريرةَ] رَضِي اللهُ عَنْهُ، أنَّ messenger of Allah صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قالَ: "مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ جَارَهُ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ".
english_translation: From Abū Hurayrah (raḍiyallāhu ʿanhu) who said that The Messenger of Allāh (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wasallam) said, 'Whoever believes in Allāh and the Last Day, let him speak goodness or else remain silent. And whoever believes in Allāh and the Last Day, let him honour his neighbour. And whoever believes in Allāh in the Last Day, let him honour his guest.'
description: This Hadith emphasizes the importance of speaking good or remaining silent, honoring one's neighbor, and honoring one's guest. It links these actions to belief in Allah and the Last Day.
